title: Rectangle Overlap
description: Check if two axis-aligned rectangles overlap by comparing their coordinates.

steps.note: Checking if rectangle 1 is completely to the left, right, above, or below rectangle 2.
Comparing coordinates: rec1_x2(2) > rec2_x1(1) and rec1_y2(2) > rec2_y1(1) and rec1_x1(0) < rec2_x2(3) and rec1_y1(0) < rec2_y2(3).
All conditions for overlap are met, returning true.
